pokedexEntries.rb: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

pokedexEntries.ye: Small and weak, this POKéMON is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.

pokedexEntries.go: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

pokedexEntries.si: It collects bones from an unknown place. A MAROWAK graveyard exists somewhere in the world, rumors say.

pokedexEntries.cr: Somewhere in the world is a cemetery just for MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.

pokedexEntries.rs: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This POKéMON’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

pokedexEntries.lg: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

pokedexEntries.em: A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

pokedexEntries.dpp: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

pokedexEntries.hg: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

pokedexEntries.ss: It collects bones from an unknown place. Some whisper that a MAROWAK graveyard exists somewhere in the world.

pokedexEntries.bw: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

pokedexEntries.x: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

pokedexEntries.y: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

pokedexEntries.oras: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokémon’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.

pokedexEntries.su: Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Pokémon is out for vengeance on its natural enemy, Mandibuzz. It throws bones like boomerangs to try to take it down.

pokedexEntries.us: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It’s thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

pokedexEntries.um: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

pokedexEntries.sh: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: The bones it uses have been in its possession since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.

pokedexEntries.za: It carries a bone that it collected from someplace unknown. Rumor has it that somewhere in the world, there is a graveyard only for Marowak.
